terms.title: Integrated Facilities Maintenance Services, Riverbend Campus
terms.agency: Example Federal Agency, Office of Facilities
terms.period_of_performance: One 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods

amounts.evidence: The ceiling for CLIN 0003 is $250,000 per period of performance (not-to-exceed).
amounts.label: ceiling

amounts.evidence: guarantees a minimum of $50,000 in orders under CLIN 0003
amounts.label: minimum guarantee

amounts.evidence: any single repair expected to exceed $5,000
amounts.label: approval threshold

amounts.evidence: general liability insurance of at least $2.5 million per occurrence
amounts.label: insurance

key_dates.evidence: Pre-proposal site visit: December 9, 2026, 10:00 AM CT
key_dates.label: Site visit

requirements.evidence: Offerors shall propose a fixed monthly price for CLINs 0001 and 0002 and fully burdened hourly labor rates for CLIN 0003.
requirements.text: Offerors shall propose a fixed monthly price for CLINs 0001 and 0002 and fully burdened hourly labor rates for CLIN 0003.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials and equipment necessary to perform facilities maintenance at the Riverbend Campus, comprising 14 buildings and approximately 620,000 square feet.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials and equipment necessary to perform facilities maintenance at the Riverbend Campus, comprising 14 buildings and approximately 620,000 square feet.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall provide a full-time on-site Program Manager who is authorized to make binding decisions on behalf of the Contractor.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall provide a full-time on-site Program Manager who is authorized to make binding decisions on behalf of the Contractor.

requirements.evidence: The Program Manager must be available by telephone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
requirements.text: The Program Manager must be available by telephone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall maintain a Quality Control Plan (QCP) and shall submit it to the Contracting Officer within 30 days after award.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall maintain a Quality Control Plan (QCP) and shall submit it to the Contracting Officer within 30 days after award.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall inspect each building monthly.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall inspect each building monthly.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall record all findings in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
requirements.text: The Contractor shall record all findings in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall perform preventive maintenance on HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire-protection systems in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and the approved Preventive Maintenance Schedule (CDRL A003).
requirements.text: The Contractor shall perform preventive maintenance on HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire-protection systems in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and the approved Preventive Maintenance Schedule (CDRL A003).

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall respond to emergency service calls within 1 hour of notification and shall restore critical systems within 4 hours.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall respond to emergency service calls within 1 hour of notification and shall restore critical systems within 4 hours.

requirements.evidence: Routine service calls shall be completed within 3 business days.
requirements.text: Routine service calls shall be completed within 3 business days.

requirements.evidence: Emergency calls will be answered by a live dispatcher at all hours.
requirements.text: Emergency calls will be answered by a live dispatcher at all hours.

requirements.evidence: The Government shall provide office space, utilities and access to the CMMS for the Contractor's on-site staff.
requirements.text: The Government shall provide office space, utilities and access to the CMMS for the Contractor's on-site staff.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall: (a) mow and edge all lawns at least weekly during the growing season; (b) clear snow and ice from walkways and parking areas within 6 hours of the end of a weather event; and (c) empty trash receptacles daily.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall: (a) mow and edge all lawns at least weekly during the growing season; (b) clear snow and ice from walkways and parking areas within 6 hours of the end of a weather event; and (c) empty trash receptacles daily.

requirements.evidence: Custodial supplies must be environmentally preferable products in accordance with EPA guidelines.
requirements.text: Custodial supplies must be environmentally preferable products in accordance with EPA guidelines.

requirements.evidence: Hazardous materials are prohibited on site without prior written approval from the Contracting Officer.
requirements.text: Hazardous materials are prohibited on site without prior written approval from the Contracting Officer.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) before beginning any single repair expected to exceed $5,000.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) before beginning any single repair expected to exceed $5,000.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall submit the Monthly Status Report (CDRL A001) by the fifth business day of each month.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall submit the Monthly Status Report (CDRL A001) by the fifth business day of each month.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall report any injury, property damage or safety incident to the COR within 24 hours using the Incident Report (CDRL A004).
requirements.text: The Contractor shall report any injury, property damage or safety incident to the COR within 24 hours using the Incident Report (CDRL A004).

requirements.evidence: The Contractor should also provide an Annual Energy Report (CDRL A006) within 30 days after the end of each period of performance.
requirements.text: The Contractor should also provide an Annual Energy Report (CDRL A006) within 30 days after the end of each period of performance.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall submit the Transition Plan (CDRL A005) within 10 days after award.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall submit the Transition Plan (CDRL A005) within 10 days after award.

requirements.evidence: Deliverables shall be submitted electronically in Microsoft Office or Adobe PDF format.
requirements.text: Deliverables shall be submitted electronically in Microsoft Office or Adobe PDF format.

requirements.evidence: All Contractor personnel shall undergo a background check before being granted unescorted access to the Riverbend Campus.
requirements.text: All Contractor personnel shall undergo a background check before being granted unescorted access to the Riverbend Campus.

requirements.evidence: Contractor personnel must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.
requirements.text: Contractor personnel must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.

requirements.evidence: Each employee must wear a Government-issued identification badge at all times while on the campus.
requirements.text: Each employee must wear a Government-issued identification badge at all times while on the campus.

requirements.evidence: A satisfactory background check is a condition of site access for every employee.
requirements.text: A satisfactory background check is a condition of site access for every employee.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall maintain general liability insurance of at least $2.5 million per occurrence.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall maintain general liability insurance of at least $2.5 million per occurrence.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall furnish a performance bond of $1,000,000 within 15 days after award.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall furnish a performance bond of $1,000,000 within 15 days after award.

requirements.evidence: The Contractor shall comply with the Service Contract Labor Standards (FAR 52.222-41) and the wage determination attached to this solicitation.
requirements.text: The Contractor shall comply with the Service Contract Labor Standards (FAR 52.222-41) and the wage determination attached to this solicitation.

requirements.evidence: Proposals shall be received no later than 2:00 PM Central Time on January 22, 2027.
requirements.text: Proposals shall be received no later than 2:00 PM Central Time on January 22, 2027.

requirements.evidence: Offerors must submit proposals electronically through the Example Agency Proposal Portal.
requirements.text: Offerors must submit proposals electronically through the Example Agency Proposal Portal.

requirements.evidence: Offerors are required to submit proposals in four separate volumes: Volume I, Technical Approach; Volume II, Management and Staffing Plan; Volume III, Past Performance; and Volume IV, Price.
requirements.text: Offerors are required to submit proposals in four separate volumes: Volume I, Technical Approach; Volume II, Management and Staffing Plan; Volume III, Past Performance; and Volume IV, Price.

requirements.evidence: Volume I shall not exceed 25 pages, excluding resumes and cover pages.
requirements.text: Volume I shall not exceed 25 pages, excluding resumes and cover pages.

requirements.evidence: Offerors shall provide at least three past performance references for contracts of similar size and scope completed within the last five years.
requirements.text: Offerors shall provide at least three past performance references for contracts of similar size and scope completed within the last five years.

requirements.evidence: Questions about this solicitation must be submitted in writing by December 15, 2026, 4:00 PM CT.
requirements.text: Questions about this solicitation must be submitted in writing by December 15, 2026, 4:00 PM CT.

requirements.evidence: Offerors must receive an acceptable rating on Factor 1 to be eligible for award.
requirements.text: Offerors must receive an acceptable rating on Factor 1 to be eligible for award.
